subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: Current source proves a remaining direct inbound parser gap, but exposing full button/options/form data consistently affects Feishu plugin behavior and compatibility beyond a purely mechanical parser reuse.

options.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, wire direct inbound `interactive` cards to the existing parser, and let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43202 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77909 own their narrower payload details.

options.title: Scope to direct inbound text
options.body: Limit this issue to top-level `interactive` message text extraction and leave form/select/action callbacks plus merge_forward entirely to the linked items.

options.title: Defer full payloads
options.body: Hold broad card/form payload exposure until maintainers decide agents should not receive full Feishu card data beyond existing text extraction.

recommendation.title: Coordinate narrow plugin fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, wire direct inbound `interactive` cards to the existing parser, and let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/43202 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77909 own their narrower payload details.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata names this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin community-maintained contact.
